frame_diagnostics.scope: Per-frame metric summaries only, no position arrays; retained locally

scope: Exposed prefix-only population signal audit; no new methods, future object targets, fresh episodes, force labels, or RGB decoded
observations: Privileged sparse SoftVT node positions and author processed PhysTwin 3D tracks; not raw-video observability
metric: Proper Kabsch to frame0 on each frame common finite valid track IDs; coordinate RMS in mm; frame0 excluded
ratios: RMS ratios, not variance explained; aggregate ratio uses point-coordinate weighted sums
limitations: Tracking noise and reconstruction error contribute to apparent nonrigid motion.
Changing visible subsets can affect framewise comparisons.
Strong observed deformation does not prove material/support identifiability.
Fresh episodes remain unopened; these rankings are development priorities, not test selection.
PhysTwin pickles are materialized by the quarantined adapter; suffix object arrays are discarded and never used by this analysis.
The 220 SoftVT episodes repeat three assets, not 220 independent object geometries.
